order_scope: shared latest state per receiver cursor
sequence_unit: latest visible value, not every send
late_joiner_window: new receivers start from current latest value and do not replay prior intermediates
reordering_posture: not a per-send history surface; intermediates are dropped
claim_ceiling: do not call this FIFO message history
notes: visibility of latest value is real even though full sequence is not
gap posture belongs in a separate gap-visibility report
